notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.23 (achievements)
notes.notes:
We have just released version 0.23 bringing stats and achievements to the game! There are up to 53 achievements planed to the full game while in the current version 51 are already available!

We hope you have fun unlocking all the available achievements, and please, share your feedback on how is the difficulty to get them.

Soon we are going to uploading final arts for all the achievements.

notes.title: Version 0.22 released! Level 5 of the cave is now available!
notes.notes:
We have released a new level based on the cave theme. It is the boss battle of the cave!

The challenge here is to beat the giant marmot controlled by the haters. Inspired on the classic boss battles of the 90s games, you are going to face changes on the behavior of the boss while beating him.

Please, share with us your feedback. Your support will help us make a great game!

notes.title: Version 0.21 released! Level 4 of the cave world is now available.
notes.notes:
We have just released a new cave level. The new level is an underwater maze where the character swiming through many challenges. You need to find the exit while avoiding enemies like the piranhas and the Hater Divers, all of that while breathing under water with the help of air bubbles that you will find. Take carefull with the water current, it can take you back to the start of the level.

Enjoy the new game level and please, share with us your valuable feedback.

notes.title: New game world with more levels coming soon
notes.notes:
We have a new pack of levels almost finished. A lot of work was done and soon we will have a game update.

There are 5 new levels within the new cave-themed game world that differ from each other as you progress through them.

The journey begins at the cave entrance; then go to a very dark area until you find a mine cart where the adventure accelerates on rails; Afterwards, we dive into the waters of a flooded area and finally find the chief living in the cave just after emerging from the water.

There are a series of new challenges and unique game mechanics coming to the next content update.

We do not have a date yet, but we are planning to finish the update as soon as possible to bring it to the players.

We have just released another minor game update concerning gameplay adjustments and minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.17
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32518405/01e21c6fe983bbdd62f6322fb7a0252998621a30.png[/img]

The update is focused in reducing game difficulty. A checkpoint is now added to each game level and areas of tension were adjusted to become easier to pass.

Patch Notes
- Checkpoints added to the game levels
- Adjustment to character movement and jumping
- Game levels adjustments
- Some enemies were removed from a variety of levels

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.16.1
notes.notes:
- The player now earns extra lives collecting hearts when already having 5 hearts
- Removed character movement deceleration when no movement input is present

notes.title: Early Access Season 2 now Available (v0.16)
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that Season 2 is now live! With version 0.16 a new game world is now playable, featuring 5 new levels, creatures, haters, challenges, gameplay variations and a new boss fight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518405/c4f0ef7ee6bdf6453f269f59d5b1ed120e1a2ff6.jpg[/img]

On the desert world Mussoumano's journey after his golden play button will face scorpions, desperate camels, sandstorm, dunes holes, quicksand and the "bizarre tribal haters".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518405/cd366c449fc29dad3b6dddd5c7eb3b3ac63eef9a.jpg[/img]

A lot of gameplay variation is present on the new levels, different challenges to push the bounds while playing the game.

This new release represents a big step through the final and complete build.

Enjoy! And please, don't forget to send us your feedback.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518405/7830144c8ed570361954b099b85dc4a07ae37e1f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518405/b8a6b1b4b8f7b148c881a8ce058dc5d7a43b43d1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: For the new players
notes.notes:
We would like to invite all the many players arriving with the promotion and others that will arrive to join the game community here on Steam.

It is very important to us that players share their feedback, bug report, ideas and critics. The Early Access is the best moment to developer and players collaboration. We want to be sure we are creating the best game possible, not only to Mussoumano’s fans, but also to platformer games enthusiasts.

Use the comments below, the discussions tab, our social media or email to share your feedback with us. This is very important, we are counting on you.

Thank you very much,
Maqna Team.

notes.title: About Season 2 (new levels – v0.16)
notes.notes:
The 2nd season is almost ready to be launched on Early Access. Our expectation is to release it on the following months, between December and January.

On season 2, the second game world will be playable. It will bring five new levels of the new desert game world with more enemies and different challenges. The final desert level will feature a new boss fight.
